main_text.l: נִבְלָתָא נבלא Chal. Cadaver, Cadivum, Morticinum,
quasi caducum aut deciduum, ut Heb. Namָ נְבֵל Heb.
Cecidit, Concidit.
מבולא, מבול Ch. Diluvium, Hab.3.5.
נבע Ch. Scaturire, Eructare, proprie de fontibus,
aquam scaturientibus dicitur: & Metaphorice
de sermone, Eloqui, proloqui. Aphel אַבִּיעַ & אַבַּע Idé:
Sic S. נַבְּעָא Aquę scaturientes, Joh.4.14.
Et eructabo abscondita, Mat.13.35.
מבועא מבוע Ch. Fons, vena, scaturigo, scatebra. Sic Sy-
riac. Jac.3.11. Plur. מבועין, const. מבועי מיין Scaturignes
aquarum, Jef.49.10.
נבך Ch. Fodere, suffodere, vastare. Futur. ex forma
Pohal, יִנּוּבְרְנָה Suffodiat eam, Psal.80.14. Hebr. יִכְרְסְמֶנָּה.
נבריא Chald. Latrones. Resp. Hebr. צמים, Jobi
18.9. Sed Jobi 5.5. transfertur לִסְטִיסִין.
נברשתא & נברשתא, נברשא Ch. Lychnuchus, Lucerna.
ננב Ch. Siccari, exsiccari, desiccari. Ithpehal אִתְנַנַּב
Idem. Ex Pah. Part. נַפְשָׁנָא מִנְגְּבָא Anima nostra
arida, Num.11.6. in Jon.
נניב Ch. Siccum. Foemin. נְגִיבְתָא, נְגִיבָא Arida, Sicca,
Gen.1.10. in Jon.
נגובתא Ch. Idem, Psal.102.7.
נונבא Ch. Siccitas, Jobi 30.30.
נגר Ch. & Syr. Trahere, abstrahere, attrahere, ex-
trahere, protrahere, subtrahere, subducere, du-
cere, diducere, extendere, inclinare. De variis re-
bus dicitur. De arcu, est Jaculari: de aquis, Flue-
re, Stillare:

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Greek-style vocalised words are copied as far as legible; several vowel points in the Hebrew and Chaldee words are doubtful and marked only in the faded scan. Some Hebrew lines (Pual/Hithpael forms, the line beginning "Et eructabo" and the mirrored Hebrew words) are only partly legible.
